tasks.title: Rolling Admission 게이트 재보정 + 동적 예산 + v1/v2 폐기 + 감사로그 교체
tasks.why: 실측 CLI 실행에서 216건 백테스트 중 0건이 observation/stress gate를 통과. 근본원인=ReliabilityGateConfig.hurdle_rate=0.15가 무근거 고정값이며, 이 프로젝트 유일의 검증된 edge(Donchian 베이스라인 점추정 CAGR 9.63%)조차 통과 못 했을 수준. shortlist_budget=24도 _SHORTLIST_PER_SIZE=6이라는 무근거 상수에서 유래. 사용자가 v1/v2 버전표기 코드 폐기와 JSONL 감사로그의 터미널 과다출력 제거도 함께 요청.
tasks.resolution: hurdle_rate를 실측 CostModel 비용배수(k=2.0 x 연환산 allocation_cost) 기반 동적값으로 대체(derive_cost_multiple_hurdle_rate, equity_span_years 신설). shortlist_budget을 probe-then-re-search 방식으로 실측 wall-time 기반 동적 도출(resolve_dynamic_shortlist_budget)로 전환. rolling 전용 v1/v2 프로필·알고리즘(_bounded_enumerate_proposals 등) 삭제, technical-5symbol-rolling 단일 프로필로 통합(정적 파이프라인의 exact_legacy_v1은 명시적으로 불변). rolling_candidate_audit.jsonl 파일 영속화를 제거하고 logging.md 스키마를 따르는 구조화 DEBUG 로그로 대체. /check 과정에서 2건의 실질 결함을 직접 재현·수정: (1) 동적 예산이 min_shortlist_budget에 의해 생성 단계에서부터 상한 걸려 실측과 무관하게 항상 8개로 고정되던 버그 - probe 이후 재탐색하도록 재구조화. (2) 수정 (1)이 노출시킨 _priority_top_n_for_size의 O(top_n) list.sort() 재정렬 latent 성능 결함(size=4/top_n=20000에서 17.4초, top_n=120000에서 행) - 고정크기 max-heap(_WorstKeptFirst, O(log top_n))으로 교체해 6.9초로 개선.
tasks.impact: 전체 회귀 테스트·mypy·ruff·lean_check 게이트 전부 PASS. 다만 max_backtest_wall_seconds_per_window=120.0 기본값이 9개 분기 전체 실측 replay에는 다소 길어(이론상 최대 18분+오버헤드) 사용자가 40분 타임아웃 실행 도중 강제 종료함 - 기본값 하향 조정 또는 단일 분기 검증이 후속 과제로 남음. hurdle 재보정의 실제 통과율 효과는 전체 replay 미완주로 아직 실측 확정되지 않음.

tasks.title: Rolling Admission v3: exact best-first 후보 탐색 재설계
tasks.why: 18-source x 5-symbol(90 expert) rolling-v2 bounded_family_unique DFS가 exhaustive 전수나열이라 첫 윈도우에서 1,000,001>1,000,000 graph-node 예산 초과로 fail-closed. 사용자가 향후 전략을 지속 추가할 계획이라, 후보를 줄이는 임시방편이 아니라 탐색 알고리즘 자체의 구조적 재검토를 요청함.
tasks.resolution: family-unique pair-compatible lattice에서 rank_key의 max항이 집합 확장에 대해 단조증가함을 이용한 exact best-first branch-and-bound(_priority_top_n_for_size, priority_shortlist_family_unique_proposals)를 신설. v1/v2는 완전 동결, technical-5symbol-rolling-v3 프로필/priority_family_unique_v3 proposal_search로 추가. 분기 실패 시 이전 분기 ledger/pointer/audit이 유실되던 결함(run_rolling_library_admission)도 함께 수정. 실행 중 발견된 별도 결함(_validate_fixed_weights의 float64 엡실론 CASH 잔여가중치 오탐)도 수정.
tasks.impact: 실측: 90개 후보 전체(prefilter 비활성)로 9개 분기 전체 COMPLETE 완주, 분기당 generated_nodes 52,680~79,606(예산의 5~8%만 사용, 이전엔 즉시 fail-closed). 216건 실백테스트 전부 실행됐으나 전 분기 CASH(no_deployable_proposal) - 인프라 병목 해소 확인, 남은 병목은 기술적 신호 라이브러리의 예측력 부재로 재확인.

tasks.title: Rolling admission 관측성·성능 및 후보 탐색 예산
tasks.why: 분기별 후보 필터링 결과를 사후 분석할 수 있어야 하고, 실제 CLI 실행에서 bounded 후보 조합 탐색이 기본 예산을 초과해 백테스트에 도달하지 못했음
tasks.resolution: 분기별 candidate audit을 즉시 append하도록 보장하고 bounded 탐색 통계를 report/audit에 기록했으며, CLI 실측 결과 18개 전략 소스와 5개 심볼 조합이 1,000,000 graph-node 예산을 초과하는 fail-closed 동작을 확인함
tasks.impact: 완료된 분기 감사 로그의 유실을 방지하고 탐색 폭발을 조용히 숨기지 않지만, 운영 가능한 후보 사전축소·심볼별 예산·CLI/profile 예산 조정이 다음 개선 과제로 명확해짐

tasks.title: 자동 후보 도출 및 분기별 롤링 라이브러리 갱신
tasks.why: 후보 선정과 백테스트를 여러 명령으로 수행해야 하고 시간이 지나면 전략 효과가 변하므로 재현 가능한 자동 갱신 파이프라인이 필요함
tasks.resolution: 후보군 도출·신뢰성/스트레스 백테스트·분기별 리밸런싱·append-only 원장·현재 프로필 포인터를 하나의 paper CLI 흐름으로 연결하고 공통 데이터 종료시각을 as_of로 제한함
tasks.impact: 분기별 최신 전략 선택과 CASH 폴백을 자동화하고 과거 결정의 멱등성·인과성·추적성을 보장함

tasks.title: Feature-owned application and CLI package layout
tasks.why: Flat application modules and one monolithic research CLI command module made feature ownership unclear and increased the cost and conflict risk of future additions.
tasks.resolution: Moved application implementations under data and research feature packages, split research CLI registration into feature-owned leaf modules, retained flat application and legacy CLI facades, and updated compatibility tests and code-map coverage.
tasks.impact: Existing typed application imports and documented CLI invocations remain compatible; future features can add one application package and one CLI leaf without editing an unrelated monolith.

tasks.title: Decompose research modules and simplify canonical filenames
tasks.why: Expert-portfolio contracts and sleeve-blend backtest mixed multiple behavioral responsibilities across large files, while application filenames repeated technical qualifiers and obscured workflow ownership.
tasks.resolution: Split expert-portfolio models, admission types, and reports; split sleeve-blend common, fixed, weights, and directional execution; retained old import paths as compatibility facades; promoted concise application module names; updated callers, tests, and code-map coverage.
tasks.impact: Public imports, CLI commands, dataclass contracts, fingerprints, causal no-lookahead weights, leverage calibration, stress reuse, and full regression behavior remain unchanged. Canonical modules are easier to locate for maintainers and AI agents.

tasks.title: Centralize research data provenance fingerprints
tasks.why: Cash-carry, open-interest, and technical-expert evaluators duplicated byte hashing and aggregate data fingerprint logic, while the canonical code map could omit production modules.
tasks.resolution: Added generic bounded-memory SHA-256 and canonical aggregate helpers, moved source mappings into domain provenance modules, rewired evaluators, added provenance regression coverage, and enforced complete canonical code-map coverage.
tasks.impact: Candidate data hashes and identifiers remain byte-for-byte compatible; missing inputs still fail closed and application workflows preserve PENDING behavior. Legacy import façades and CLI contracts remain intact.

tasks.title: Contextual library admission backtest research run
tasks.why: 등록·catalog 변경 없이 선택한 proposal 또는 expert 조합의 contextual master-ledger와 stress 성과를 재현하고 provenance에 기록
tasks.resolution: proposal_id/expert 목록 기반 library-admission-backtest CLI를 실행하고 base/stress 결과를 append-only runs ledger에 저장
tasks.impact: 선정 후보 조합의 실제 성과와 promotion 판정을 scratch 파일 없이 재현 가능

tasks.title: Deterministic contextual expert-library routing
tasks.why: Expert 후보별 gate만으로는 상황별 specialist 선택이라는 의도를 구현하지 못했고, library 승격 단위와 router provenance가 명확히 필요했다.
tasks.resolution: Added a causal six-state contextual winner router with block-aware conditional LCB, CASH fallback, next-bar turnover accounting, router-preserving blueprint fingerprints, strict context alignment, and composite master-ledger promotion tests. Kept ML deferred until a deterministic routed library has sealed evidence.
tasks.impact: The runtime can now evaluate a pre-registered contextual library as one master equity, while the default catalog remains empty and CLI fails closed until an approved expert combination and router configuration are source-controlled and registered.

tasks.title: Technical expert short equity exhaustion fail-closed handling
tasks.why: Short backtests could produce non-positive marked equity and crash the reliability gate.
tasks.resolution: Raised DataIntegrityError at equity exhaustion and converted evaluation failures into pending reports.
tasks.impact: Previously crashing short CLI runs now terminate safely as PENDING without invalid reliability metrics.

tasks.title: OI deleveraging sealed multi-symbol gate evaluation
tasks.why: The fixed sleeve needed an independent return source to reduce fold concentration.
tasks.resolution: Collected causal daily metrics and evaluated open_interest_deleveraging_v1 across BTC, ETH, AVAX, BNB, and DOGE under unchanged gates.
tasks.impact: All five symbols were rejected and the candidate remains excluded from the expert catalog.

tasks.title: Provenance ledger and grouped CLI consolidation
tasks.why: Expert registration and CLI entrypoints had divergent schemas and duplicated workflow files.
tasks.resolution: Consolidated registration, evaluation, and retirement provenance into a typed runs ledger with grouped CLI adapters and fingerprint-verified expert catalogs.
tasks.impact: Future strategies add catalog and command entries without new run scripts or registry files while legacy provenance remains queryable.

tasks.title: Expert portfolio runtime execution and fail-closed diagnosis
tasks.why: 실제 parquet 실행으로 전문가 포트폴리오의 등록·배분 경로와 게이트 결과를 검증해야 했다.
tasks.resolution: CLI는 미등록 library에서 중단되었고 등록을 우회한 BTC·ETH 코어 실행은 LCB 비양수로 전액 현금에 머문 결과를 ADR과 결정 인덱스에 기록했다.
tasks.impact: 전문가 포트폴리오는 아직 promotion 불가이며 expert_library_registry 등록과 양의 LCB를 생성하는 독립 전략 증거가 다음 필수 작업으로 남았다.

tasks.title: Funding signed directional sleeve 구현 및 sealed gate 검증
tasks.why: 고정 5심볼 롱 전용 sleeve의 fold 집중을 완화할 인과적 방향·펀딩 레짐 후보를 검증하기 위해 구현했다.
tasks.resolution: funding_signed_directional_v1과 causal inverse-volatility sizing을 연결하고 351개 테스트·ruff·mypy·lean_check를 통과시켰으며 sealed CLI 실행 결과를 확인했다.
tasks.impact: CAGR 1.44%, observation LCB90 0.04%, fold 0.4056, stress FAIL로 promotion은 REJECTED이며 기존 fold threshold 완화 근거는 없다.

tasks.title: 고정 슬리브 멀티심볼 Donchian 블렌드 + MDD-예산 레버리지 구현
tasks.why: 단일전략 의존과 보수적 사이징이 gate 실패의 원인이라는 사용자 지적에 따라, 분산투자+원칙적 레버리지가 observation gate를 통과시킬 수 있는지 검증 필요
tasks.resolution: BTC+ETH+AVAX+BNB+DOGE 동일가중 블렌드(src/research/sleeve_blend/) 구현, MDD 예산(게이트 플로어의 85%) 기반 정적 레버리지 산출(Kelly 아님, v6 파산 사례 반영). 실행 결과 observation PASS(LCB90 15.12%), stress PASS, fold_gate만 FAIL(0.4899)
tasks.impact: promotion은 여전히 REJECTED이나 병목이 observation hurdle에서 fold-concentration 단일 게이트로 좁혀짐; 5가지 독립 구성(단일심볼/알트/횡단면모멘텀/유동성포트폴리오/이번블렌드) 전부 fold<0.40 미달로 구조적 병목 확정, 기술적 레버 소진 - fold-gate 방법론 정책 결정이 다음 필수 단계

tasks.title: Donchian 과거 데이터 확장 및 신규 전략/다심볼 알파 탐색 마감
tasks.why: BTCUSDT Donchian이 fold 집중도(2023년 76~82% 독점) 및 LCB90 hurdle 미달로 REJECTED; 다심볼/신규전략이 대안인지 실측 필요
tasks.resolution: BTC+8알트 과거데이터 실백필(2019/2020~), 13심볼 재검증(BTC 최선 확인), mean-reversion/횡단면모멘텀 파일럿 반증, taker-flow 재검증(불충분), collect_funding CLI 서브커맨드 신설. fold_max 0.7585→0.4599, stress PASS 전환
tasks.impact: BTCUSDT REJECTED 유지되나 gate 품질 대폭 개선(observation FAIL만 잔존, hurdle 정책은 사용자 결정으로 유지); 다심볼·평균회귀·횡단면모멘텀 경로는 반증되어 재탐색 불필요; 다음 가설=funding-rate 레짐 확인 필터

tasks.title: Cash-carry 신호 히스테리시스 및 마진 현실화
tasks.why: BTCUSDT carry가 매 funding 정산 단발부호로 열고닫혀 왕복비용(0.42%)이 funding 캡처분(0.01~0.05%)의 10~40배를 반복 지불(CAGR -41.37%, win_rate 0%)
tasks.resolution: 비용기반 히스테리시스 밴드(CarryHysteresisConfig)와 마진 버퍼 현실화(0.10/0.05→0.30/0.15)를 도입, 재실행 결과 trade_count 0으로 무비용 net carry 자체가 부재함을 확인
tasks.impact: 426건 REJECTED(전 게이트 FAIL)가 0건 PENDING(표본부족, gate_pass=True on fold)으로 전환되어 손실이 정직한 무엣지 보고로 교정됨; BTCUSDT 후보는 은퇴하고 alt 심볼 spot+borrow 데이터 확보가 다음 과제

tasks.title: Incremental source and test architecture refactor
tasks.why: Flat layer modules and cross-layer imports made feature changes and test ownership difficult to locate.
tasks.resolution: Reorganized canonical code into common, market_data, research, application, and behavior-aligned tests while retaining legacy import façades and CLI contracts.
tasks.impact: Three backtest workflows and their stored performance semantics remain reproducible while task indexes and code maps become canonical-path based.

tasks.title: Binance Margin borrow history collection
tasks.why: Cash-carry evaluation was blocked because Binance quote-borrow history was not persisted in the canonical spot lake.
tasks.resolution: Added signed Binance Margin interest-rate collection, interval-cost conversion, canonical borrow persistence, CLI wiring, tests, and synchronized all spec artifacts.
tasks.impact: Borrow collection now succeeds for the sealed window, while carry remains pending until existing funding timestamp jitter is normalized.

tasks.title: Cash-carry Phase B independent data and sealed evaluation
tasks.why: Phase B was blocked because the independent spot OHLCV and quote-borrow history inputs were absent, and the carry CLI mixed IO, hashing, and gate execution.
tasks.resolution: Implemented the canonical spot lake and ohlcv_store atomic write path, the Binance spot collector, canonical borrow import with explicit accrual cadence, explicit 1h-to-4h carry loading, funding/borrow interval-aligned target, append-only candidate pre-registration, idempotent anti-pattern evidence, and split the CLI into register/run commands.
tasks.impact: All 198 tests pass with strict mypy and ruff; the sealed run reports PENDING until a reproducible historical quote-borrow export covering the observation window is supplied, and the borrowed data pipeline now fail-closes on any unit ambiguity or coverage gap.

tasks.title: Basis carry Phase A and data storage synchronization
tasks.why: Phase A carry ledger and futures storage consolidation are implemented, while Phase B remains blocked on independent spot and borrow data.
tasks.resolution: Recorded the implemented carry contracts, canonical futures storage layout, normalized collection path, and the remaining Phase B gate prerequisites.
tasks.impact: Future work must collect and validate spot OHLCV and borrow data before one sealed observation run plus stress evaluation.

tasks.title: Fix portfolio initial liquidity diagnostic
tasks.why: The CLI logged an empty initial universe because it queried the first bar before a complete trailing liquidity window existed.
tasks.resolution: Moved the diagnostic as-of timestamp to the first common 30-day eligible window and added a regression assertion rejecting selected=[] logs.
tasks.impact: Initial universe logs now show a causal non-empty selection while the engine's daily selection and promotion gates remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Causal liquidity portfolio v2 evaluation
tasks.why: Compare the implemented five-slot liquidity portfolio against the frozen BTC reliability gates.
tasks.resolution: Recorded the latest portfolio run as rejected because observation LCB90, t-stat, fold concentration, and stress gates failed.
tasks.impact: CAGR rose to 16.41% but LCB90 fell to 1.84%, MDD widened to -20.83%, and promotion remains fail-closed.

tasks.title: Taker-flow confirmation candidate evaluation
tasks.why: Evaluate the opt-in quote-notional taker-flow filter with funding-net accounting against frozen reliability gates.
tasks.resolution: Recorded the sealed BTCUSDT candidate CLI run and retained it as rejected because observation and fold gates still fail.
tasks.impact: Candidate improved CAGR to 10.45% and Sharpe to 1.571 with MDD -7.00% while preserving the v1 default and promotion safeguards.

tasks.title: Harden lean_check test mapping and coverage collection
tasks.why: Strict basename matching and leaf-module coverage caused false failures despite valid tests and passing implementation checks.
tasks.resolution: Added AST-based semantic test matching, package-level coverage collection, script exclusion from source coverage, and regression tests.
tasks.impact: The audit now accepts feature-named tests and completes deterministic contract, typing, pytest, and coverage verification.

tasks.title: Codebase Directory Reorganization and Config Centralization
tasks.why: Flat module structure in src root caused scattered config variables and circular import risks as features expanded.
tasks.resolution: Reorganized codebase into layered subpackages (core, data, strategy, engine, validation, cli) and synchronized unit and integration tests.
tasks.impact: Eliminated duplicate variable definitions, enforced unidirectional layer architecture, and established clean maintainability for scaling.

tasks.title: Align lean_check.py with Spec Contract Schema
tasks.why: lean_check.py failed spec-compliance validation due to schema mismatch.
tasks.resolution: Updated _check_spec_compliance in lean_check.py to support file/symbol keys, python_assertion exec evaluation, and flexible wiring matching.
tasks.impact: Restores automated spec-compliance gate verification without breaking legacy contract formats.

tasks.title: Reliability Gate Protocol Implementation
tasks.why: Evaluates strategy robustness via block bootstrap LCB90 CAGR, fold distribution concentration, and cost/delay execution stress test.
tasks.resolution: Implemented compute_reliability_gate, split_holdout_segment, compute_fold_distribution, compute_stress_test_gate, and recorded metrics in runs.jsonl.
tasks.impact: Provides robust, data-driven gate criteria preventing overfitted or regime-dependent strategies from passing into production.

tasks.title: Full Reset — Donchian Breakout Baseline (v1)
tasks.why: 208k-LOC L1/L2 research stack (74.5k src + 140.5k tests) had no reproducible edge; every metric was untraceable across multi-symbol/multi-TF fitted layers
tasks.resolution: Archived legacy/domain/application/tests to legacy/reset_20260731 (git tag pre-reset-20260731), kept only the data-collection carve-out (src/data/*), rebuilt a flat 0-fitted-parameter Donchian(20)/EMA(200)/ATR(14,2.0) engine with frozen StrategySpec+CostModel, and fixed a signal-bar-ATR causality bug (engine used atr[t] instead of atr[t-1] for stop sizing) caught by /check against the frozen SC-BASE-01 baseline
tasks.impact: BTCUSDT 4h observation window 2022-04~2025-12: 91 trades, CAGR 9.63%, MDD -7.47%, Sharpe 1.40, PF 2.25 vs buy&hold CAGR 24.77%/MDD -60.58%/Sharpe 0.70 — risk-adjusted not absolute edge; 29/29 tests + mypy strict + ruff clean; 2026 H1 held out and sealed
